scope.flow: swap and multihop swap execution in Router.sol without a deadline parameter
scope.environment: AMM router contract (Router.sol) with swap, multihopSwap, multiMultihopSwap functions

statements.text: Alice submits a swap transaction (3000 USDC to 1 WETH with a minimum of 2990 USDC worth) at 10:00 AM.
The submitted transaction has low gas priority and sits in the mempool during network congestion.
By 3:00 PM market conditions have deteriorated (market crashes -20%) since the transaction was submitted.
The swap and multihop functions lack a deadline parameter, so no deadline timestamp is checked before execution.
The stale transaction finally executes at 3:00 PM after sitting in the mempool.
A swap or multihop swap submitted with a deadline timestamp must not execute after that deadline; execution after the deadline should revert.
A pending swap transaction must not be executable at unexpected times when market conditions have become unfavourable relative to submission.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the swap functions are callable by anyone or any authorization condition; no unauthorized-caller precondition asserted.
The deadline value (10:30 AM) appears only in a hypothetical 'with deadline protection' scenario, not as an actual submitted parameter.
Report does not specify the exact slippage percentage bound; 'up to slippage % value loss' is left unquantified.
Whether the transaction was actually observed executing at 3:00 PM is presented as an example scenario, not a confirmed on-chain event.
